component: MIME news charset lookup result handling

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Inside the existing successful I18N-URL branch, the news charset lookup sets rv to failure before optional server and NNTP-interface lookup. Only GetCharset on a found NNTP server replaces that result. Success supplies the charset; otherwise the branch uses UTF-8. This prevents reuse of an earlier successful result in that branch. It does not establish that a generic news URL reaches the outer I18N guard or prove a fresh charset/runtime result.
title: The optional NNTP charset lookup starts with failure before selecting a fallback
